description:
*“That team leader is a regular fan, what the heck is going on~”

In the past, due to financial difficulties, Seo-Jin used to do male cam activities on a high-level gay site. Although he wasn’t popular, he had a regular fan who would give him sponsorship money for every word he said. However, Seo-Jin blacks out at the last drinking party and is forcibly kicked out of the site with only a large amount of sponsorship money. A few years later, they reunite at work as a team leader and a new employee. The money he received as sponsorship money has long since been spent. To the frozen Seo-Jin, the team leader (?) makes an offer he can’t refuse… No matter the place! No matter the time! Seo-Jin’s chaotic office life begins now as he goes against the no-break calls of the perverted team leader.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes 14 side story chapters**
